The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 179f73885d0c7f47), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. statement: Let Γ be a finitely presented torsion-free one-ended group with no nontrivial splitting over a finite or two-ended subgroup. Suppose it acts minimally by convergence on a nondegenerate compact metric continuum B whose set P of global cut points is nonempty. Then there is a nontrivial minimal simplicial Γ-tree T , with no edge inversions and finite quotient, such that: (i) P is an invariant subset of its vertices, and every edge has one endpoint in P and one outside P; (ii) T is spanned by P; its other vertices have degree at least two; (iii) every edge stabilizer is infinite; (iv) if a, b, q ∈ P and q separates a, b in B, then q ∈ [a, b]T . Every point of P is fixed by an infinite-order parabolic element.
